operations.name: pdfs.upload
operations.description: Upload a PDF from this computer, like dropping it on the app: an absolute path to a .pdf file (starts with %PDF, max 100 MB).

page_count.description: Number of pages; needed only when the app answers that it cannot count them (compressed page list). Checked against the file whenever the file is readable.

operations.name: splits.preview
operations.description: Check a split without doing it: the same rules as the split controls, and the files it would make (file names and page ranges).

pdf.description: PDF id, or its exact file name

split_type.description: pages = one file per selected page; ranges = one file per range; every_n = a file every n pages

pages.description: For pages: a JSON list [1, 3, 5], ranges to select like 1-3, 8, or all

ranges.description: For ranges: like 1-5, 8, 11-15 (a single page is its own range)

n.description: For every_n: pages per file, 1 to the page count (default 2)
